    # Fill in the project name with 'chatgpt_plugin?'
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name').fill('chatgpt_plugin?')
    # Click the checkbox to uncheck it, ensuring an empty repository
    checkbox = page.get_by_role('checkbox', name='Initialize repository with a README')
    await checkbox.wait_for(state='visible')
    await checkbox.click()  # Click to toggle and uncheck
    # Click the 'Create project' button to submit the form
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Create project').click()
    # Wait for navigation or confirmation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
